NoSQLServer v0.22 validation
============================
Runtime: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 (64-bit)

New acceptance:
  NOSQLSERVER V0.22 EXISTS/SELF-JOIN HARDENING SMOKE: OK
  Hell corpus: 4 PASS / 8 UNSUPPORTED / 13 PARSE_ERROR / 0 WRONG_RESULT / 0 EXECUTION_ERROR
  Hell PASS queries 3, 4, 5 and 8 are independently oracle-backed.

External acceptance retained:
  Claude torture: 12/12 PASS, all oracle-backed
  Grok feature harness: 72/72
  SQL-92 company smoke: OK

Correctness repair:
  Hell query 8 exposed a self-join alias collision in the older two-table join path.
  Before repair it returned SUCCESS with 0 rows. The alias-aware INNER_HASH_CHAIN
  now returns the 9 correct manager/employee rows and the hell oracle verifies order
  and salary relation.

Deliberate boundaries:
  RIGHT JOIN and FULL JOIN remain SQLUNSUPPORTED.
  Other hell frontier/composite queries remain cleanly unsupported or parse-rejected
  until their semantics are implemented and oracle-backed.
